info.title: C4M
info.description: API for managing content-related operations in the Parapet system.

post.summary: Archives an unpublished page with no unarchived children, retaining its content and history.

409.description: The page is published, has unarchived children, or is referenced by menus.

post.description: Creates a new page with the specified content blocks, optionally leaving its initial version as a draft.

400.description: The request is invalid or would create a cycle.

409.description: A page with the same path already exists.

get.summary: Lists pages with pagination, sorting, and filtering.
get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of pages with support for sorting, searching by SEO title or path, and filtering by slug, path, and creation/update dates.
Retrieves a specific page by its unique identifier including all related blocks. Optionally specify a version ID to get a specific version, otherwise returns the current version.

404.description: The page was not found or the specified version does not exist.

put.summary: Creates a content and SEO draft without changing page details or publication.

get.description: Retrieves a specific page by path including all related blocks. Returns the current version of the page.

404.description: The page was not found for the specified path.

get.description: Retrieves a specific page by its version identifier including all related blocks.

404.description: The page was not found or the specified version does not exist.

put.summary: Sets a page version as current.
put.description: Sets the specified page version as the current version and unsets the previous current version.

200.description: Page version was successfully set as current.

404.description: The page version was not found.

get.summary: Gets page version history by page ID.
get.description: Retrieves the complete version history for a specific page, including high-level change summaries.

get.summary: Gets a page path by ID.
get.description: Retrieves just the path of a specific page by its unique identifier. This is a performance-optimized endpoint that returns only the path without loading the full page data.

get.summary: Checks whether a page path is available.
get.description: Resolves the path a page would have with the given parent and slug, and reports whether that path can be used. Pass the ID of a page being edited to exclude it from the check.

400.description: The slug or IDs were invalid.

post.summary: Publishes the saved Current version of a page.
Moves all unarchived direct children and their subtrees to another parent or the top level.

404.description: The source page was not found.

409.description: The destination or resulting paths are invalid.

post.summary: Unpublishes a page unless published pages or menus reference it.

204.description: The page is unpublished; its history is retained.

409.description: References block unpublishing, or the publication state changed.

put.summary: Updates unversioned page details without creating a content version.

get.description: Retrieves the default navigation and footer menu selections.

put.description: Changes the default navigation and footer menus immediately.

post.summary: Creates a new menu action type.
post.description: Adds a new menu action type to the system.

201.description: menu action type was successfully created.

409.description: A menu action type with the same name and version already exists.

get.description: Retrieves all available menu action types with their schemas.

200.description: Menu action types were successfully retrieved.

get.summary: Gets a menu action type by ID.
get.description: Retrieves a menu action type including its JSON schema for validation.

200.description: Menu action type was successfully retrieved.

404.description: The menu action type was not found.

get.summary: Gets a menu action type by name.
get.description: Retrieves a specific menu action type from the system by its name. If version is not specified, returns the latest version.

200.description: Menu action type was successfully retrieved.

404.description: Menu action type was not found.

post.description: Adds a new menu with optional menu items to the system.

409.description: A menu with the same name already exists.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of menus.
Retrieves the menu configured as the site-wide navigation fallback.

200.description: The default menu was successfully retrieved.

get.description: Retrieves the menu configured for the site-wide footer.

200.description: The footer menu was successfully retrieved.

get.description: Retrieves a menu with its hierarchical structure of menu items.

put.description: Replaces all menu items with the provided tree structure.

409.description: Version conflict detected. The menu has been modified by another user.

post.description: Adds a new block type to the system.

409.description: A block type with the same name and version already exists.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of block types grouped by name. All versions of each block type are included together.

get.summary: Gets a block type by ID.
get.description: Retrieves a specific block type from the system.

get.summary: Gets a block type by name.
get.description: Retrieves a specific block type from the system by its name. If version is not specified, returns the latest version.
